summary: Track 19.16 Phase B2 frontend testing. Public /near-miss kiosk renders anonymously, submit button correctly disabled until required fields filled. Draft Resume Banner on /incidents/report works end-to-end (absent on fresh session, present after pick+back, Resume navigates to steps, Discard clears). Legacy /incidents/new still renders (no redirect). B1 vehicle_accident picker still works. NOTE: Immediate Danger alert did NOT appear after clicking near-miss-danger-yes in headless Chromium — this may indicate a bug OR a click-not-registering artifact; needs main-agent verification. Full submit flow + bilingual + idempotency were NOT verified because the script errored out at the alert assertion and could not proceed further within remaining budget.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking [data-testid=near-miss-danger-yes] with fields filled, [data-testid=near-miss-immediate-danger-alert] not found within 30s. Either the yes-toggle is not flipping form.immediate_danger to true, or the alert render is conditionally skipped. Verify manually — could be a real bug (blocks acceptance criterion #3) OR test artifact.

action_items: URGENT: Manually verify that clicking near-miss-danger-yes toggles form.immediate_danger=true and renders near-miss-immediate-danger-alert. If bug is real, likely fix is in the button onClick handler or the aria-pressed toggle logic in NearMissKiosk.jsx around line 353-360.
Re-run full kiosk submit + case_number + bilingual + idempotency test after alert issue is resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: NearMissKiosk.jsx submit button label switches to 'Save & queue' when offline — good UX; ensure translations exist in i18n.js.
incidentOfflineQueue.js correctly sends X-Idempotency-Key header AND idempotency_key in body — matches Phase A backend contract.
DraftResumeBanner rendered inside IncidentTypePicker only when draft.incident_type is present — correct gating.

success_rate.frontend: 70% (5 of 7 B2 criteria verified; alert + full submit + bilingual + idempotency unverified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Kiosk loads without auth. Submit disable/enable works. Draft banner absent/present/resume/discard works. Legacy /incidents/new not redirected — good. UNVERIFIED: (a) immediate-danger alert appearance after clicking near-miss-danger-yes (test showed alert NOT visible — could be real bug OR click not registering in headless), (b) full submit → success screen → case_number pattern \d{4}-\d{5}, (c) EN↔ES bilingual toggle, (d) idempotency duplicate flag, (e) accessibility spot-checks (aria-live on online pill, aria-pressed on danger toggles, aria-required on textarea, aria-label on photo button — code inspection confirms these attributes ARE present in NearMissKiosk.jsx source, so likely GREEN).
rca of the issue: Immediate danger alert failure — either (1) real bug in state toggle, (2) React re-render race in Playwright, or (3) button hit-target issue. Recommend main agent to manually click danger-yes in browser and inspect DOM. Source code inspection shows the toggle is a simple setField('immediate_danger', true) and conditional render {form.immediate_danger && <EmergencyAlert />} — logic looks correct, so bug is unlikely but not impossible.
